name: A-One Steels India Limited
description: We have six manufacturing facilities of which five are located in Karnataka and one in Andhra Pradesh. Our manufacturing facilities are backward-integrated plants where the iron ore journeys from processing to sponge iron production, and our dynamic processes transform iron ore into MS Billets and then into TMT bars, HR Coil, CR Coil, HR pipes, CR pipes and galvanized tubes and pipes.
